metadata.name: portfolio_allocator
metadata.description: Custodian-signed allocation and unwind mediator for composable portfolios

instructions.name: accept_vault_role
docs: Claims the vault's AssetManager role for the portfolio's custodian.

accounts.name: governance
docs: Governance authorises the claim; the custodian PDA performs it.

instructions.name: allocate
docs: Deposits custody USDC into a pool vault, then enforces the weight band.

accounts.name: factory_config
docs: Factory-owned; `Account` checks the owner against the factory's ID,
which the shared state crate declares.

accounts.name: pool_deposit_whitelist
docs: The custodian's entry on this pool's deposit whitelist.
The core reads it from `remaining_accounts` and refuses the deposit if
it is absent, so the allocator has to forward it. Passing it explicitly
rather than relaying whatever the caller appended means the derivation
is checked here, by the program that knows which custodian and which
pool this is (F13).

accounts.name: nav_scratch
docs: `portfolio_nav` scratch PDA. Empty / uncreated = no crank in flight.

instructions.name: create_custodian
docs: Creates the system-owned custodian PDA and the portfolio's tracker.
Callable only through an authenticated factory CPI.

accounts.name: factory_authority
docs: The factory's authority PDA. Being a signer is what proves this is a
factory CPI, and it pays for both accounts created here.

accounts.name: custodian
docs: The custodian is created by hand rather than with `#[account(init)]`.
Anchor's `init` would assign program ownership, and the System Program
refuses to move lamports out of a program-owned account. The custodian
has to pay rent for `WithdrawalRequest` accounts, so it must stay
system-owned with zero data.

instructions.name: init_custody
docs: Creates a canonical custody ATA for the underlying or a pool's shares.

accounts.name: portfolio_vault
docs: The portfolio's vault, which names both the custodian and the
underlying mint this custody set is allowed to hold.

instructions.name: reconcile_unwind
docs: Drops a tracked unwind whose core request has closed.

accounts.name: withdrawal_request
docs: The core `WithdrawalRequest` this tracker entry refers to.
Passed unchecked because the point of the instruction is to observe
whether it still exists: once the core closes it after fulfilment or
cancellation, the account is system-owned with no data. The address is
compared against the tracked one, so a substituted account cannot be
used to retire a live request.

instructions.name: request_unwind
docs: Asks a pool vault to redeem shares, recording why the unwind is allowed.

accounts.name: custodian
docs: core request, which is the reason it must stay system-owned.

accounts.name: nav_scratch
docs: `portfolio_nav` scratch PDA. Empty / uncreated = no crank in flight.

instructions.name: return_to_vault
docs: Moves custody USDC back to the vault. Permissionless by design.

accounts.name: custodian_underlying_account
docs: The custodian's USDC ATA. The core checks the mint; the ownership check
here is what stops a caller draining custody to an account they control.

fields.name: max_legs
docs: Stored as `u16` so v1 can raise to 32 without a type change.
Legs live on `PositionPage` PDAs, not on this header.

fields.name: max_idle_buffer
docs: Becomes `max_total_idle` — undeployed cash only, not a TVL cap.

fields.name: factory_tx_margin_lamports
docs: Read by `required_factory_rent()`; never sourced off-chain.

fields.name: custodian_tx_margin_lamports
docs: Read by `required_custodian_reserve()`.

fields.name: keeper_risk_paused
docs: Blocks deposits/allocate/unwind/fees; never fulfilment or return.

fields.name: deployed_risk_budget
docs: Monitoring target; hard exposure bounds are per-pool caps.

types.name: PageLeg
docs: One held pool on a `PositionPage`.
`weight_bps == 0` means exiting (in the manifest, not in current targets).

types.name: PendingCooldowns
docs: Pending cooldown changes waiting for approval

types.name: PendingFees
docs: Pending fee changes waiting for approval

types.name: PendingLimits
docs: Pending limits changes waiting for approval

types.name: PendingPrice
docs: Pending price update waiting for approval

types.name: PendingRoles
docs: Pending roles change waiting for per-role incoming-holder claims

types.name: PendingTargets
docs: Header-only pending change. The set lives on `PendingTargetsAccount`.

types.name: PendingWhitelist
docs: Pending whitelist changes waiting for approval

types.name: PendingWithdrawalParams
docs: Pending withdrawal parameter changes waiting for approval

fields.name: redemption_estimate_secs
docs: Conservative estimate; floors `Portfolio.rebalance_delay_secs`.
Capped at 30 days at registration (`MAX_NOTICE_SECS`).

fields.name: risk_tier
docs: Disclosed input, not a guarantee.

fields.name: max_execution_loss_bps
docs: Atomic min-out bound; an async breach halts or quarantines the pool.

fields.name: pool_reserve_ratio_bps
docs: Published reserve target; keeper-enforced and monitored.

fields.name: risk_disclosure_hash
docs: Canonical JSON factors/assumptions served by the API.

types.name: Portfolio
docs: Portfolio header. Targets and positions live on `PositionPage` PDAs.
Task 5 breaking resize: no in-account targets/positions vecs.
Account traits are hand-implemented so a live 445-byte header (no
`book_seq`) still deserializes after the upgrade. Discriminator, owner, and
serialize match `#[account]`.

fields.name: pending_targets
docs: Timestamps only. The proposed set is `PendingTargetsAccount`.

fields.name: book_seq
docs: Bumped on apply finalize and `retire_position`. NAV pages snapshot this
so a book mutation mid-crank cannot publish a mixed-page mark.

types.name: PositionPage
docs: One page of the position manifest.
Seeds: `["portfolio_page", portfolio, page_index.to_le_bytes()]`.

types.name: RoleKind
docs: Vault role kind for per-role claim (`accept_role_assignment`)

fields.name: justification
docs: Exactly one reason, per spec 5.3.

types.name: VaultConfig
docs: The main vault state that manages user deposits, withdrawals, and management fees.
This struct represents an S-Token vault that:
- Accepts deposits in an underlying token
- Issues shares representing vault ownership
- Manages fees and profit distribution
- Enforces access controls and limits

fields.name: max_deviation_bps

fields.name: last_price_update_timestamp

fields.name: price_acceptance_cooldown_secs

fields.name: next_withdrawal_id

fields.name: withdrawal_ttl_secs

fields.name: system_penalty_bps
